page_title: LYO 1-2 CLE | Lyon v Clermont 22/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' The referee is firm and issues Mory Diaw (Clermont) a deserved yellow card.
90+5' What was Elbasan Rashani (Clermont) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
90+5' Clinton Mata (Lyon) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
90+3' Jake O'Brien (Lyon) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Willy Delajod had an easy-decision to make.
90+2' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) escapes his marker to connect with a cross and heads it low towards the left side of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent save to deny him.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Johan Gastien (Clermont) launches a cross from the corner, but Anthony Lopes is alert to thwart the effort.

90' Elbasan Rashani (Clermont) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The referee points to the corner flag and Clermont will take a corner.
90' Bilal Boutobba (Clermont) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
87' Pascal Gastien appears to have said too much and referee Willy Delajod comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
86' Alidu Seidu (Clermont) has tested the patience of referee Willy Delajod and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
84' Alidu Seidu (Clermont) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Maximiliano Caufriez.
83' Fabio Grosso has decided to substitute Henrique and he is replaced by Sael Kumbedi (Lyon).
83' A substitution has been made. Jim Allevinah is replaced by Mehdi Zeffane (Clermont).
81' The game has come to an end for Muhammed Cham. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Bilal Boutobba (Clermont).
80' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
79' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
74' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) takes the free kick from mid-range, but he balloons his effort high over the bar. What a miskick! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Clermont.
72' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) was too forceful with his tackle and Willy Delajod interrupted the game to signal a free kick. It's a free kick to Clermont in a dangerous position.
69' Substitution. Elbasan Rashani (Clermont) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Maxime Gonalons walks off.
68' Pascal Gastien has decided to make a change. Habib Keita (Clermont) replaces Yohan Magnin.
68' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jeffinho will be replaced by Mama Balde (Lyon).
67' Yellow card. Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.

66' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the top left corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Mory Diaw pulls off an easy save.

61' Good chance! Mahamadou Diawara (Lyon) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored! The ball goes out of play and Clermont will have a goal kick.
57' This shall not pass! Maxime Gonalons (Clermont) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
54' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

52' 1 - 2 Florent Ogier (Clermont) attempts to head the ball away after a cross into the penalty area, but instead he accidentally sends it inside the right post of his own goal. The goalkeeper was helpless.
52' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
52' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) fires the resulting free kick on goal from a medium range, but sees his shot saved by the goalkeeper. Lyon will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
51' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) will take the free kick.

51' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Florent Ogier (Clermont). Willy Delajod saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Lyon earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.

49' A cross by Mahamadou Diawara (Lyon) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Clermont.
49' The corner kick from Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
48' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) works the corner short.

48' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence. The ball goes out of play. Lyon are awarded a corner kick.
47' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety. Lyon earn a corner.
46' Fabio Grosso has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Corentin Tolisso comes on the pitch for Rayan Cherki (Lyon).
46' The game is over for Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon). Mahamadou Diawara comes on for the second half.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Paul Akouokou (Lyon) comes off for Ernest Nuamah.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+6' Willy Delajod blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) whips in a cross from the corner, but Mory Diaw is well positioned and punches the ball away.
45+1' Willy Delajod shows a yellow card to Florent Ogier (Clermont) for his blatant foul.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) takes the corner with a short pass.
45' Henrique (Lyon) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the top left corner, but Mory Diaw shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
43' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) muscles his way past two defenders but his shot from inside the box smashes against the crossbar!
41' Johan Gastien (Clermont) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

41' Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) finds himself some space just outside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Anthony Lopes pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going inside the right post. Clermont have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
40' Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
39' Jeffinho (Lyon) picks up the ball and goes on a great solo run. He decides to shoot from mid-range but his attempt is comfortably blocked by a defender.
38' Mory Diaw comes off his line to intercept the corner from Maxence Caqueret (Lyon).

38' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The linesman points to the corner flag, Lyon are going to take it.

35' 0 - 2 Yohan Magnin (Clermont) scores one of the best goals in his career. His rocket of a shot from distance goes straight into the top right corner. They will be showing this on every football show for some time to come.

35' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) produces a long-range cannon of a shot after a nice pass. The ball heads towards the top left corner, but is stopped by a great save from Anthony Lopes and the score remains the same.
34' Henrique (Lyon) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mory Diaw intercepts the ball.
32' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Henrique (Lyon) was quite harsh and Willy Delajod didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
31' Lyon are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
28' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) sprays a pass out to Alexandre Lacazette, but he can't beat his man inside the box.

25' Willy Delajod blows his whistle as Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. Clermont win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.

23' Clinton Mata (Lyon) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the right post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better! The ball goes out of play and Clermont will have a goal kick.
22' Johan Gastien (Clermont) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
21' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
21' Cheick Oumar Konate (Clermont) wastes no time in going for goal after collecting a rebound, but his long-range effort is comfortably blocked by a defender.
20' Johan Gastien (Clermont) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
19' Yellow card. Dejan Lovren (Lyon) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
18' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
16' Jeffinho almost found himself in a promising position after Rayan Cherki (Lyon) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception.
13' Referee Willy Delajod points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Clermont players celebrate.
11' Wait! The referee has now indicated he wants to check if the goal for Clermont can stand using VAR.
10' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Shamar Nicholson puts the ball on a plate for Muhammed Cham (Clermont), who has an easy finish with a header into an empty net. The score is 0:1.
10' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mory Diaw, who smothers the ball.
9' Johan Gastien (Clermont) trips an opposition player and Willy Delajod signals a foul. Lyon are awarded a free kick.
7' Some great controlled play and passing from Lyon. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
4' Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
3' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
2' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lyon will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Willy Delajod.
